## Step 2. Fix the grader and extend the selftest

In `spe/evals/harness/grader.js`, I replace the priority compare with this:

```js
function normPriority(v) {
  return String(v ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()
}

function priorityMatch(got, want) {
  const g = normPriority(got)
  return g !== '' && g === normPriority(want)
}
```

In `spe/evals/harness/grader.selftest.js`, I add these cases:

```js
assert(priorityMatch('p1', 'P1'), 'lowercase label must pass')
assert(priorityMatch(' P1 ', 'P1'), 'padded label must pass')
assert(!priorityMatch('P2', 'P1'), 'wrong label must fail')
assert(!priorityMatch('', 'P1'), 'empty must fail')
assert(!priorityMatch(undefined, 'P1'), 'missing must fail')
```

Then I run the selftest. The oracle must pass, empty and wrong answers must fail, and the new case and whitespace variants must pass. If any check fails, I stop here and report.

```

git commit -m "SPE r03 evaluate (harness): compare priorities after trim and uppercase (F7)"
```
